review: I sit with dying people twice a week and I bring a small speaker in a canvas bag. Almost nothing on this site is usable in that room. Anything with a build, a swell, or a key change is wrong — a person in their last hours does not need to be taken somewhere, and music that arrives somewhere is asking them to come along. This album never arrives. "Kitchen Light at Six" has been playing in the room three times now when somebody died, and each time it was the right thing, and I do not know how to explain that to whoever made it except by saying so.
